opportunities.source_name: OpenGov — County of San Mateo, CA
opportunities.title: Facility Condition Assessment and Asset Management Solution
opportunities.description: The County of San Mateo (County) is soliciting competitive proposals from qualified firms to deliver a turnkey Facility Condition Assessment (FCA), compile a unified Master Equipment Register (MER), deploy an enterprise-grade cloud Facility Condition Information System (FCIS), and implement bi-directional integration with the County’s Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) IBM Maximo Application Suite SaaS. This solicitation is structured into two distinct operational phases: PHASE 1 (BASE SCOPE) : Complete on-site baseline Facility Condition Assessments across approximately 100 facilities (~4.5 million gross square feet across 75 sites) following ASTM E2018-24 standards. Perform discrete equipment nameplate inventories and install durable 2D physical barcode tags for maintainable mechanical, electrical, plumbing, conveyance, and life-safety systems. Compile and validate a unified Master Equipment Register (MER) that establishes an identical data baseline between IBM Maximo and the FCIS. Provide, configure, and host a SaaS-based FCIS platform delivering real-time Facility Condition Index (FCI) calculations, multi-year capital renewal modeling, and localized RSMeans-based cost estimating. Format, validate, and batch-load the complete Master Equipment Register directly into the County’s IBM Maximo Application Suite environment, and establish automated synchronization between Maximo and the FCIS. PHASE 2 (OPTIONAL/ADD-ALTERNATIVE SCOPE): Develop standard, manufacturer-aligned Preventive Maintenance (PM) Job Plans, task check-sheets, and recommended service frequencies, pre-formatted for direct batch upload into Maximo Job Plans and PM Master applications.

opportunities.title: ServiceNow Maintenance
opportunities.description: The County of San Mateo is seeking quotations for: ServiceNow maintenance services. The San Mateo County Sheriff’s Office utilizes a custom-built portal in ServiceNow for all Fiscal, Training, and Technical Services Unit related requests which are routed to each respective bureau. This system incorporates detailed workflows, approvals, and County and Sheriff’s Office procurement, training, and invoicing policies and procedures. Contractor must adhere to County Technology Services Department change request schedule and process. Contractor will provide upkeep, maintenance, and enhancements as needed to the ServiceNow application. Enhancements include, but are not limited to: Integration of Docusign electronic signature capability. Adjustments to existing approval workflows. Adjustments to existing PDF document generation functionality. Adjustments to existing email notifications. Creation of additional dashboards and reports. General administrative and support tasks, including: User roles and permissions Group management Changes to assignment and routing Manual case data updates as required. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: Contractor must have provided ongoing ServiceNow maintenance for a customized platform for a local government entity for at least two years – preferably for a law enforcement agency. FEE: Costs should be billed at a flat hourly rate. Total hours will be shared between Fiscal, Technical Services, and Training. Please complete the Pricing Bid Table in section 3 and please also upload your competitive quotation. Cost and conformity to specifications in the scope of this RFQ will be considered. After an evaluation of all quotations, a County contract is expected to be awarded in association with the lowest, responsive bid received from a qualified, responsible vendor.

opportunities.title: Maintenance Support for Priority Dispatch Software Sole Source 26-27
opportunities.description: Escambia County Public Safety is accepting quotes for Maintenance Support for Priority Dispatch Software for FY27 (10/01/2026 – 09/30/2027). Scope of Services: Routine Maintenance: Perform regular updates, patches, and version upgrades of Priority Dispatch software as released by the vendor. Conduct proactive system health checks and performance monitoring to identify and address potential issues promptly. Technical Support: Provide expert-level technical assistance and troubleshooting for users encountering issues with Priority Dispatch software. Ensure rapid response and resolution of software-related incidents and service requests. Must provide support within 30 minutes for system outages. Bug Fixing and Software Updates: Investigate reported bugs or anomalies in Priority Dispatch software and apply necessary fixes or workarounds. Collaborate closely for bug fixes and updates, leveraging proficient programming skills as needed. Provide software updates promptly as they become available, covering expenses related to the update process. Enhancements, Customization, and Interfaces: Modify the original software source code as necessary to implement enhancements and fixes. Provide canned and customizable reports that interface with the Priority Dispatch database to pull report data from the software. Security Management: Implement and maintain robust security measures to protect Priority Dispatch software against vulnerabilities. VPN Connection Provisioning: Provide and maintain a Virtual Private Network (VPN) connection for personnel to securely access Priority Dispatch software during support activities. Ensure VPN connectivity is reliable, secure, and compliant with organizational security policies. Documentation and Reporting: Maintain detailed records of all maintenance activities, including updates, fixes, enhancements, and source code modifications made to Priority Dispatch software. User Support and Training: Offer advanced user support services, including in-depth guidance on utilizing Priority Dispatch software effectively and resolving complex issues. Provide training sessions as needed for users on new features, enhancements, or changes implemented in Priority Dispatch software. Service Level Agreement (SLA): Provided 24/7/365 support availability, rapid response times (must provide support within 30 minutes for system outages), and expedited resolution times for critical incidents. Establish clear escalation procedures for unresolved issues or emergencies. Access to Source Code: The respondent must have access to the original software source code of Priority Dispatch software to facilitate modifications for enhancements, fixes, and customization as required by Escambia County Public Safety. Software Updates: The respondent is responsible for providing software updates promptly as they become available from the vendor, covering all expenses related to acquiring and implementing these updates. Qualifications and Experience: The respondent must demonstrate: Extensive knowledge of Priority Dispatch software and its underlying technologies. Experience in providing round-the-clock support services for mission-critical applications, modifying source code, delivering software updates, managing VPN connections, and developing software interfaces. Deliverables: Updated documentation reflecting any configurations, fixes, enhancements, and software update details. Records demonstrating user support interactions. Timeline: Provide a schedule for routine maintenance activities, including planned updates and maintenance windows. Specify any anticipated downtime or service disruptions associated with maintenance tasks, VPN connection upgrades, and software updates. Contact Information: Designate a primary point of contact for service requests, escalations, and general inquiries related to maintenance support, software updates, and contract administration. Provide contact details for the 24/7/365 support line. Appendix: Include any additional documents or appendices pertinent to the maintenance support of Priority Dispatch software, software update management, and contract administration.

opportunities.title: Moving Services
opportunities.description: The County of San Mateo (the “County” or “SMC”) covers most of the San Francisco Peninsula. The region covers 744 square miles and is home to nearly 800,000 residents and 20 incorporated cities. The County provides for the health and welfare of all people within its borders and serves as the local government for the unincorporated areas. Innovation thrives here in industries including bioscience, computer software, green technology, hospitality, financial management, health care, education and transportation. The County prides itself on how that prosperity fosters its commitment to protecting and enhancing the health, safety, welfare and natural resources of the community. Formed in July 2014, the San Mateo County Sustainability Department strives to improve the sustainability of the County’s operations and the greater community through work that is designed to bring solutions today while solving for tomorrow. The Sustainability Department has programs to help the county both fight and prepare for climate change, ensure clean energy, water, and air, and conserve resources for future generations through waste reduction. The Sustainability Department has approximately 40 staff members and provides services in the following areas: Communications, Climate Resilience, Climate Protection, Waste Reduction, and Special Districts with similar but varying community needs. The department is seeking a vendor that can move office furnishings between and sometimes within buildings, including but not limited to technology items such office pods.

opportunities.title: P-57907 Enterprise Monitoring
opportunities.description: The City of Pasadena is seeking a vendor to provide an Enterprise Monitoring solution and associated implementation and support services. The goal of the Enterprise Monitoring project is to strengthen alert management and monitoring processes , and to proactively identify and address system performance issues before they impact customers. The City seeks a unified monitoring and observability platform that provides centralized visibility across infrastructure, networks, cloud services, databases, applications, integrations, and business services. The desired solution will correlate events and performance data across technology domains, improve operational awareness, reduce alert fatigue, accelerate root cause analysis, and enable proactive management of service health and availability. The platform should support the City's current hybrid and multi-cloud environment while providing a scalable foundation for future operational monitoring and automation initiatives.

opportunities.title: Wood Pole Inspection, Treatment, Repair, and UAV Inspection Services
opportunities.description: The City of Pasadena Water and Power Department (“PWP”) is seeking proposals from qualified and experienced firms to provide wood pole inspection, repair, restoration, treatment, and related reporting services for PWP’s electric distribution system. The selected firm will support PWP’s ongoing maintenance and compliance program for wood poles, including visual inspections, intrusive inspections, groundline inspections, preservative treatments, minor corrective repairs, pole reinforcement recommendations, installation of approved repair materials, and detailed reporting of observed conditions. PWP’s wood pole program is intended to support safe, reliable, and compliant operation of the electric distribution system in accordance with applicable requirements, including California Public Utilities Commission (“CPUC”) General Order 95, Rules for Overhead Electric Line Construction, and CPUC General Order 165, Inspection Requirements for Electric Distribution and Transmission Facilities. PWP’s system includes approximately 11,000 wood poles, including both municipally owned and jointly owned poles. A significant portion of the pole population is located in rear property or otherwise constrained access locations. The scope of services may include, but is not limited to, pole condition assessment, identification of structural damage or decay, inspection for General Order 95 infractions, groundline and below-ground inspections, preservative and fumigant treatment, installation of visibility strips, guy guards, ground molding, pole tags, and steel truss reinforcement where approved by PWP. The selected firm shall also provide detailed inspection records, photographs, condition ratings, repair recommendations, and electronic data deliverables in a format acceptable to PWP. In addition to conventional field inspection and treatment services, PWP intends to include drone or other unmanned aerial vehicle (“UAV”) inspection services under the resulting contract. UAV services may be used to supplement field inspections, improve access to difficult or hazardous locations, document pole-top conditions, capture high-resolution imagery, and support more efficient assessment of pole attachments, crossarms, hardware, conductors, insulators, and other visible overhead facilities. UAV services shall be performed by qualified, FAA-compliant personnel and in accordance with all applicable federal, state, and local requirements. The selected firm shall furnish all supervision, labor, materials, equipment, vehicles, tools, technology, software, transportation, permits, methods, processes, and incidentals necessary to complete the work in accordance with the final scope of services, applicable laws and regulations, industry standards, and PWP requirements.

opportunities.title: Rental Registry Database and Portal
opportunities.description: The City of Pasadena Rent Stabilization Department is seeking proposals from qualified vendors to provide a comprehensive rental registry database and online portal. The selected vendor will be responsible to meet the City's need for implementing, operating, and maintaining a system that supports the requirements of City Charter Article XVIII, which governs rent stabilization in Pasadena. The Department requires a fully hosted online platform that enables landlords to register rental units, update unit and tenancy information, apply for exemptions, and pay the City’s annual rental registry fee, including any applicable late fees. The system must also allow landlords to submit any rent registration-related notices or documents mandated by the Charter or any applicable federal, state, or local laws directly to the City through the registry portal. A Rental Registry is a core, foundational tool to monitor compliance with Charter Article XVIII to ensure that rent adjustments are in compliance with local law. There are approximately 26,000+ rental units registered within the City of Pasadena Rent Stabilization Department's Rental Registry. Rental property owners are required to register on annual basis and pay a registration fee for each rental unit. Exemptions for the annual registration fee are available and processed through the Rental Registry. Outside of the annual rental registration window from September-October, rental property owners are required to utilize the system to record key events including, but not limited to, occupancy amendments, rent increases and transfer of ownerships. The Rent Stabilization launched its Rental Registry on September 2024. It contains data for approximately 26,000+ rental units. Online payments can be made via eCheck and through Payroc via debit/credit card. A key desire for the next system is to integrate with Tyler Cashiering. City Charter Article XVIII can be accessed via this link: https://library.municode.com/ca/pasadena/codes/code_of_ordinances?nodeId=CH_ARTXVIIIPAFAEQHOCHAM . Adopted regulations concerning rental registration, Chapter 9, are available on the Pasadena Rent Stabilization Website via this link: https://www.cityofpasadena.net/rent-stabilization/notices-forms-resources/#regulations
